encoding: ASCII lines terminated by CRLF; requests may use LF
numbers: Unsigned decimal without sign; CRC and token components are eight uppercase hexadecimal digits

token.security: Change detector only, not authentication or collision-resistant identity. Includes no invented boot/device identity.

semantics.submission: CAPS/STATUS/ENTER/POLL/CANCEL are synchronous RAM operations. ENTER acknowledges an atomic boot-latched START exclusion, not writer cleanup. Valid LIST/META/READ submit one operation; LoggerTask alone advances it. Reserved DELETE is synchronously rejected as UNSUPPORTED. POLL returns PENDING until complete; completion is replayable until the next accepted request or CANCEL. Match operation/request_id/file_id/token/offset.
semantics.list: cursor=0 starts enumeration; next_cursor is opaque uint32. One entry per reply. Only fixed six-digit mission directories containing flight.sslog are exposed. closed means no active writer, not proof of successful recording/finalization.
semantics.storage_owner: Only LoggerTask performs FatFs work. Hash input is at most 512 bytes and READ data at most 64 bytes per step; open/seek/close and directory work can involve multiple SD operations. These byte limits do not establish a time bound. No FatFs in SerialTask or ISR.
semantics.safety: Explicit ENTER is required. In PREFLIGHT/READY/POSTFLIGHT it atomically reserves maintenance only when no START request/transaction or configuration action is active; every START entrance immediately rejects while reserved, never queues for later. LoggerTask waits for bootstrap/recovery to finish, stops producer admission, drains, flushes, closes its writer and writes final status before maintenance READY. Failures latch FAILED and never authorize reads. LIST/META/READ require READY, a healthy mounted store, no open writer and a non-flight lifecycle. Boot-time historical reads are supported after this quiescence. Maintenance remains latched after cancellation, disconnect and completion; physical reboot is required before flight preparation. No radio/AIR/GSP bulk binding, remote delete or automatic restart.
semantics.read: META must first compute full-file CRC32 and size in this service instance. READ requires matching cached file_id/token and unchanged length. Offset <= size; response up to 64 original bytes. Client validates each chunk CRC and final size/whole CRC, then atomically publishes. CRC32 is ISO-HDLC (zlib.crc32), empty CRC=00000000.
semantics.resume: With unknown device or boot identity, disconnect, cancellation, timeout and reboot invalidate all partial downloads and cached selection. Repeat CAPS+META and restart read-only download at offset zero; a matching CRC/size or prefix does not authorize continuation. Never mix responses from another request. No SSLOG bytes or Descriptor are rewritten.
semantics.delete: Reserved explicit command. Current implementation advertises delete_supported=0 and always returns UNSUPPORTED, because device_id/boot_id are unknown. No unlink is performed. A future identity-capable version requires an independent user confirmation and full identity/content validation; old confirmation never survives a reconnect.
semantics.timeout: 30 seconds without POLL cancels outstanding file work and invalidates cached metadata; POLL updates liveness. Existing diskio timeouts bound individual device transactions only; no whole FatFs/task WCET or total cancellation deadline is established. CANCEL cancelled=1 acknowledges acceptance, cleanup_complete=0 explicitly does not claim closure. STATUS cleanup_pending remains 1 until owner reset/close returns; close failure latches maintenance FAILED. Cancellation never releases maintenance or permits START.
semantics.compatibility: Older firmware lacking LOGFILE or status_version/maintenance_required reports unsupported for the relevant feature. GSHC disables device listing/download without explicit maintenance/START exclusion. AIR M0 and SSLOG0 bytes remain unchanged; exact .ssdecoder and embedded Descriptor remain required by FLP. Legacy flat directories are not enumerated.
semantics.status: status_version=1 is an additive capability. STATUS copies a LoggerTask-published RAM snapshot and current maintenance/cleanup state; it never probes media or touches FatFs. sequence is a wrapping sample counter, not a request or boot identity; age_ms is saturated elapsed time since that sample. The receiver adds host receive age and marks stale after 3 seconds, invalidates on disconnect/unsupported/error, and never presents unknown storage fields as zero. Missing snapshot returns NOT_READY. lifecycle is an observation, not authorization to START. maintenance: 0 OFF, 1 DRAINING, 2 READY, 3 FAILED. finalization: 0 IDLE, 1 ARMED, 2 DRAINING, 3 FINALIZED. firmware is product identity, independent of wire versions.
